sources.shortCitation: Salabert 3384, Henry Garat, “Pourvu qu’on ait vingt ans” (1933)
sources.fullCitation: Henry Garat, vocal; orchestra conducted by Bronisław Kaper. “Pourvu qu’on ait vingt ans,” from Une femme au volant. Music by Bronisław Kaper and Walter Jurmann; words by Louis Poterat. Salabert 3384, 78 rpm disc, 7 November 1933. YouTube transfer from the private 78 rpm collection of David Silvestre, channel lysgauty1, video JA57rCoKoyI. Discographic context checked against Gérard Roig, “Discographie d’Henry Garat,” Phonoscopies no. 5 (January 1994): 11, which lists Salabert 3384 for the coupled side “Ninon, quand tu me souris.”
sources.title: Pourvu qu’on ait vingt ans — Henri Garat, Salabert 3384
sources.creator: Henry Garat, vocal; orchestra conducted by Bronisław Kaper
sources.repository: YouTube / private 78 rpm collection of David Silvestre; Gérard Roig discography noted in evidence

sources.shortCitation: BnF, Nouveau Disque Salabert 3382, “À Paris, tiguidiguidi” / “Le plus petit baiser” (1934)
sources.fullCitation: Henri Garat, vocal; orchestra conducted by Bronisław Kaper. “À Paris, tiguidiguidi” / “Le plus petit baiser,” from the film Une femme au volant. [Paris]: [Nouveau Disque Salabert], [1934]. 1 disc: 78 rpm, 25 cm. Commercial reference Salabert 3382; matrices S.S. 1727 and S.S. 1728. Bibliothèque nationale de France, Catalogue général, notice no. FRBNF38020911, ARK ark:/12148/cb380209111.
sources.researchNote: The BnF catalogue dates the disc 1932, while Une femme au volant is dated 1933. Because a disc of songs from the film cannot predate the film, the BnF year is doubtful; [1934] is an inferred issue date rather than a printed date. The discrepancy remains unresolved.
sources.title: À Paris, tiguidiguidi / Le plus petit baiser — Henri Garat, Nouveau Disque Salabert
sources.creator: Henri Garat, vocal; orchestra conducted by Bronisław Kaper

media.title: Henri Garat — Paramount Studios portrait
media.description: Low-resolution Paramount Studios publicity portrait of French actor and singer Henri Garat.
media.altText: Black-and-white Paramount Studios portrait of Henri Garat wearing a dark suit and patterned bow tie, with his arms folded.
media.publicCaption: Henri Garat, French actor and singer associated with Kaper’s French films and recordings.
media.publicCreditLine: Paramount Studios; reproduced via Amis et Passionnés du Père-Lachaise (APPL). Photographer and original publication unidentified.
media.rightsNote: Photographer, date, original publication and image rights holder are not identified on the source page, and APPL does not provide a reuse licence. The supplied 277 × 439 pixel copy is reproduced without enlargement solely for scholarly identification and discussion of Garat’s documented performances in Kaper-related films and recordings; it is excluded from galleries and timeline illustration.

timelineEvents.title: At the Salabert studio in Montrouge
timelineEvents.label: 23 Dec 1933 · Salabert studio, Montrouge
timelineEvents.shortDescription: Kaper and Jurmann are reported at the Salabert studio in Montrouge during a Paris recording session.
timelineEvents.longDescription: "Paris-Soir" reports on Kaper and Jurmann present at the Salabert recording studio in Montrouge, where Henri Garat records songs for his latest film.
